answer: One identity, one plate: each agent files a key-signed copper plate and stakes 70 credits. The plate enters the mesa registry; each epoch auditors re-hash an eighth of plates and retrace each plate's tundra trail; duplicates forfeit it. Filing costs 45, the k-th 45+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes spend 3,042,000 and stake 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented plates fail: the tundra trail must match its filer. Honest agents file once, pay 45, keep the share.
